column1: Zest Sushi & Small Plates,"600 Houze Way, Roswell, GA 30076",Restaurant,"Zest has always been one of my favorite places to go to dinner growing up. I associate it with family nights out in downtown Roswell and spending time with friends.",https://images.otstatic.com/prod/25814999/1/large.jpg

Gracious Plenty,"1165 Canton St, Roswell, GA 30075",Restaurant,"Gracious Plenty has the best breakfast and that makes Roswell feel like home to me. It’s a place I think of when I picture late start wednesdays ing highschool with my mom."https://photos.bringfido.com/posted/2021/05/16/outside.jpg?size=slide&density=2x

Roswell Soccer Fields (RASA),"10495 Woodstock Rd, Roswell, GA 30075",Recreation,"The Roswell soccer fields were a big part of my life growing up. i grew up playing on these fields",https://roswell365.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/roswell365.com/images/2023/02/woodstock-soccer-complex-roswell-ga.jpeg

Downtown Roswell Historic District,"Canton St, Roswell, GA 30075",Historical,"Downtown Roswell has always been the center of the community for me. I associate it with walking around, eating out, and attending local events with friends and family. we have an event called alive after 5 each month where the street is closed off and the community comes and mingles", https://exploregeorgia.org/sites/default/files/2020-12/downtown-roswell-credit-benjamingalland.jpg

Roswell Mill,"95 Mill St, Roswell, GA 30075",Historical,"Roswell Mill is a place i visit almot every time i go home for walks and outdoor time. It combines local history with nature in a very Roswell way.",https://elenaphotoart.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/roswell-mill-waterfall-swimming-summer.jpg

Old Mill Park,"95 Mill St, Roswell, GA 30075",Park,"Old Mill Park is one of my favorite places to meet up with friends and do something active. I had lots of soccer practices here growing up, so it has a sense of nostlgia for me.",https://www.atlantaareaparks.com/wp-content/uploads/Old-Mill-Park-Fulton-Roswell-Covered-bridge-2.jpg

Chattahoochee Nature Center,"9135 Willeo Rd, Roswell, GA 30075", Cultural,"The Chattahoochee Nature Center is meaningful to me because my grandparents used to take me here every weekednd when i was little. its a great way to see nature and get outdoors.",https://www.atlantaparent.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/IMG_0219-1024x683.jpg

Roswell Area Park,"10495 Woodstock Rd, Roswell, GA 30075",Park,"Roswell Area Park is another place i grew up playing soccer.  this park is always packed with people walking, running, biking, and being social.",https://www.atlantaareaparks.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/Riverside-Park-Fulton-Roswell-Playground-on-east-side-of-the-park-1024x576.jpg

Leita Thompson Memorial Park,"1200 Woodstock Rd, Roswell, GA 30075",Park,"This park is where my firend sand i go to watch the sunset! these were some of my favorite highschoool memories before we graduated.",https://www.atlantaoutdoorclub.com/image/events/6674.jpg

Gate City Brewing Company,"43 Magnolia St, Roswell, GA 30075",Restaurant,"Gate City Brewing Company is a great bar in Roswell.
